theme: Breaking down iconic real-world entities, industries, brands, and historical movements into structured animated documentary guides

visual_style.character_design: Simple vector-art digital avatars in colored circular badge frames, expressive and minimal
visual_style.scene_setup: Each badge represents an era/model/milestone; avatar changes outfit, expression, and background color to match context. Timeline flows left-to-right or chronologically
visual_style.color_palette: Vibrant, distinct background color per era/circle badge, clear year/era label underneath. High contrast, accessible colors

voice_style: Energetic narrator with documentary pacing, short punchy sentences, occasional light humor, clear pronunciation
